subject.title: Feature: Built-in pace-aware rate limiting for autonomous agents

question: Should OpenClaw add core pace-aware quota policy for autonomous agents, and should the first phase be visibility-only or enforcement?
rationale: The request adds provider policy, session/runtime behavior, and a new config surface, so code inspection cannot decide the intended product boundary.

options.title: Phase 1 visibility only
options.body: Expose pace/headroom context through status/session_status using the existing provider-usage hooks while deferring enforcement.

options.title: Opt-in core enforcement
options.body: Add a new explicit config and migration/test plan for throttling subagents or non-interactive work.

options.title: Plugin/API-first
options.body: Keep enforcement outside core unless a missing plugin API blocks a maintained extension from implementing it.

recommendation.title: Phase 1 visibility only
recommendation.body: Expose pace/headroom context through status/session_status using the existing provider-usage hooks while deferring enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent provider-usage/status/session-suspension work is the closest current owner boundary for this decision.
